name: cubito
description: Aplicación de gestión del hogar para Alex y Sandra

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
